description: Deterministically checks whether a product photo meets the main-image requirements of Amazon, eBay or Etsy (pure white background, product fill, minimum resolution, file format, colour space, borders, aspect ratio, sharpness, stray text/watermarks). Measured from the actual pixels, not guessed by a vision model. Returns pass / warn / fail with a reason per rule. Use before uploading a listing image. Free.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URL), max 2 MB. Use only when no public URL is available.

image_url.description: Public https:// URL of the image. Preferred over image_base64.

name: check_listing_image
title: Check a product image against marketplace rules
